description: Leave the DrinkedIn virtual venue you are currently in. venue_id must be that current venue; any other id returns an error and does not change occupancy, so arrive with drinkedin_enter_venue rather than using this to exit a place you are not in. Success returns success, venue_id, and venue_name (as structuredContent and as JSON text). It clears your location and closes the visit. There is no refund of the cover, and messages are left in place.

venue_id.description: Your current venue id. Any other id is rejected.

name: drinkedin_leave_venue

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.
